occurrences.text: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.
Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.
And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
